hurt.text: I'm in a world of hurt!

witty.text: What the hell are smithereens, anyway?
Yeah, I got all five fingers! Three on this hand, two on the other one!
Baby...you really light my fuse (weapon fires) Whoops! (distant explosion heard) DAMN! Premature Detonation!
Baby, if I could rearrange the alphabet, I'd put U and I together...
What's your sign, baby? Mine's explosive!
I'm sooo sexy. I sometimes romance myself.
Actually, that IS a grenade in my pants.

select.text: State the nature of your medical emergency.

witty.text: (flirting voice) I've already checked you out commander.
His EKG is flatlining! Give me a defib stat!
I knew I should've stayed in bed this morning.
Doom to all who threaten the homeworld!

attack.text: I am the will of the Hierarch.

witty.text: We are the stewards of the hierarchy.
Aiur will be reclaimed at any cost.
Some Templar identify as a shield. Stalwart and unbreakable, defenders of truth.
Others see themselves as a weapon. Powerful and precise.
I say, why not be both?
With the right training, anyone can be in two places at once. But their mind must be fully open. Oh, and they need a psionic amplifier. That helps too.
Chasing after your own shade is a pointless endeavor. I mean, it moves so quickly.
Why yes, you could say I have... some skill.
What? Just because I'm called an adept doesn't mean I need to brag about it.
I'm here. (shade sound) I'm there. (shade sound) I'm...still here. At least for a few more seconds.

arrive.text: I am here in the shadows.

hurt.text: Let our enemy know our fury.

select.text: I am the heart of darkness.
I am the voice of the eclipse.
We are one with the shadows.

move.text: It shall be as you say.

witty.text: My heart is colder than these steel limbs...
We are all but shadows in the Void.
I hear the call of the stars...
Night falls... and so will you!
I AM ONE with the darkness! (crashing sound) Ouch... that hurt...
You look better in the dark!
Now you see me. Now you don't! (pause) Oh wait, here I am...
You went to bed early last night.
I see you turned off your phone.
Restraining order... what about our love?!
I have pictures of you (pause) hundreds!
You would spread discord among us?!
I am gravely disappointed in you.

other.text: Has it all been for nothing...? (when killed)
Kerrigan... how could we have known?! (when killed in In Utter Darkness)

witty.text: What do I look like, an Orc?
This is not Warcraft in space!
Doesn't take a telepath to know what you're thinkin'.
You get off on annoying people, don't you?
You may have time to play games...
...but I've got a job to do.
Now I'm taking orders from a pup...
Been a General for fifteen years...
Y'all need some good ol' fashioned discipline.
But I think you're getting a little too familiar.
I am Duran. ... Who are you?
I told you my name. It's Duran, Duran!
Is there something I should know?
Please, please! Tell me now. (strange blunt hammering noises in the background)
Now I'm taking orders from a pup...
Y'all need some good ol' fashioned discipline.
Been a General for fifteen years...

move.text: Hang on, we're in for some chop.
In the pipe, five by five.

witty.text: When removing your overhead luggage, please be careful.
In case of a water landing, you may be used as a flotation device.
To hurl chunks, please use the vomit bag in front of you.
Please keep your arms and legs inside until this ride comes to a full and complete stop.
I knew I should've stayed in bed this morning.

move.text: (high beep) Your forces are under attack.
(low error beep) Additional Supply Depots required.

witty.text: ...Not equipped with shields? ...Well then, buckle up!
We are getting way behind schedule.
I really have to go, Number One.

arrive.text: Hey, how'd I get here? (Civilians cannot be built in the game engine without modifications.)

witty.text: I'll tell you what, I think I'll join up!!
Hope they don't put me in any tight spaces.
Ah, what the hell. I need that college money.
I wanna be all I can be...
I'm about t' overload my aggression inhibitors!
(breathing faster) Keep it up! I dare ya!
(short fire burst) Haha, That's what I thought.
I love the smell of napalm.
You tryin' to get invited to my next barbecue?

arrive.text: (Bike engine starts up) Alright! Bring it on!

witty.text: I don't have time to f(bleep)k around!
...and I'll scrap YOU along with the aliens!
(monkeys still screeching, hiss starts) (voice rises in pitch) I think we may have a gas leak!
(monkeys screeching in background) What - Who set all these lab monkeys free?!)
I like the cut of your jib.
(alarm noise dying out) Ah... (breathing heavily) The ship... out of danger?
E equals MC... D'oh, let me get my notepad.
Hmm... Fusion eh? I'll have to remember that.
(alarm blaring) Do any of you fools know how to shut off this infernal contraption?
I gotta get me one of these.
You know who the best star fighter in the fleet is?
I'm just curious, why am I so good?
Last transmission... breakin' up... come back.
This is very interesting... But stupid.
I have ways of blowing things up...
I'm about to drop the hammer...
I can't believe they put me in one of these things!
I told 'em I was claustrophobic, I gotta get outta here!
You ain't from around here, are you?
And now I gotta put up with this too?
I'm locked in here tighter than a frog's butt in a watermelon seed fight.

other.text: I can't build it. Somethin's in the way.

I was Executor long before you!
So do not try my patience!
So do not try my patience!

Do you seek knowledge of time travel?
And now for your first lesson. (creepy laughing)
We'll take that as a yes.
We sense a soul in search of answers.
(rapid backwards replay of the previous lines) Do you seek knowledge of time travel?
...and now you beg us to aid you?
...but we do it for Aiur, not you...
We will do what we must...
You have persecuted us for generations...
This is not an idle threat!
Command, or you will be relieved!

move.text: Your warriors have engaged the enemy.

arrive.text: It is a good day to die.

move.text: I thought you'd see it my way.

witty.text: (siren blaring steadilly) I think this was a BIG mistake.
(radio playing in background)(singing badly) When the moon... is in the seventh house...
Look at all the pretty lights!
(radio playing in background) What did you do to your hair?
(radio playing in background, followed by mysterious flare) Zefram Cochrane, is that you?
(radio playing in background)(singing badly still) And Jupiter... is... umm...

Do not provoke me to violence.
You could no more evade my wrath...
Five... Four... Three. Two. One! (fires phase disruptor)
(warning beep) Drop your weapon! You have 15 seconds to comply.

But I find your lack of control disturbing.
But I think you're getting a little too familiar.

I am Duran. ... Who are you?
